system.description:
Requirements: Soul (5), 6 Stormcaller abilities, and you must receive training from another Tempest Herald, or have access to their teachings.

Cost: 2 Resolve

Range: Self

You have achieved mastery over the malefic energy suffusing your body, making an unstoppable engine of destruction.

As an Action, you may transform into a dragon made of malefic lightning.

  • Your Body and Soul increase by +2.

  • You gain a Fly speed of 5. If you already have a Fly Speed, it increases by +5.

  • You are immune to all conditions except Dying.

  • If you start Dying, you are not stunned.

  • Once per turn, when you inflict Damage to a creature afflicted with a condition, suffering from Stormcaller ability, or affected by a Hazard, you may choose to increase the damage by an amount equal to your Soul.

This effect lasts until the end of combat, you become Incapacitated, or you are Dying. After you use this ability, you cannot use any ability with the Apex trait until you complete a Long Rest.

Additionally, Stormcallers and followers of the Weeping Dragon will recognize your skill and afford you special respect.
